newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury's Summers endorses Mexico peso policy.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury's Summers endorses Mexico peso policy.

text.p: U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers on Thursday endorsed Mexico's policy of allowing the peso to find its own level in the foreign exchange market based on the economic fundamentals.
"It's the right policy for Mexico in this economic context," he told CNBC television.
"What's important for Mexico...is to concentrate on the economic fundamentals and to make sure they're sound," he said. "The Mexicans have done a good deal toward that objective.
"If you do that, fluctations in currency values will take care of themselves," Summers continued.
He made his comments in response to a question about the recent weakness of the Mexican peso.
